text:
Maria Chen: FYI customer reported apparent double billing when a toolcall was deferred and then retried after stream truncation. Seen on prod-nyc.
Samir Patel: ugh can you paste the logs / request id? :eyes: 
Maria Chen: here's minimal repro from logs:
Maria Chen: ```
req_id=01F3XZZZ session=abc123 route=canonical-tool v=2
stream_chunk: seq=0 tokens=32
truncate=client_eof
defer_toolcall id=tc:xd-99 retry_after=0.8
toolcall: invocation_id=inv-789 tokens=48 status=200
billing: provisional_tokens=80 confirmed=48
``` 
Samir Patel: looks like we credited the streaming tokens (32) + toolcall tokens (48) instead of replacing chunk tokens when toolcall completes
Kevin O'Hare: is the toolcall being emitted as a separate subrequest? We should be de-duping if toolcall_id matches. Do we have idempotency token for deferred toolcalls?
Liz Wong: console shows per-route breakdown: stream=32, toolcall=48, total=80 — confusing for customers when toolcall replaces streaming suffix. We need clarity in UI
Tara Singh: is this a billing vs telemetry mismatch? i.e., ledger shows provisional true until confirmation, but console aggregates both
Maria Chen: looks like provisional flags weren't cleared on resume. The router reattached session and emitted deferred toolcall which got billed as new
ops-bot: ALERT: 1 customer reported unexpected invoice delta (ticket #C-2245)
Kevin O'Hare: internal API debate: attribute tokens on chunk emission (current) vs on final acknowledgement (proposal). Doing final ack reduces overcharge but complicates realtime billing and quotas
Samir Patel: could we special-case deferred toolcalls: when deferred_toolcall attaches within X sec, subtract earlier provisional chunk tokens associated with same session/prefix ?
Liz Wong: UX ask: show "provisional" badge and "confirmed" line items per session in console. Also add hover: why tokens changed
Tara Singh: telemetry: add trace tag toolcall_deferred=true and link tracelet->invocation_id so we can reconcile ledger automatically
Maria Chen: agreed. Proposal: add router dedupe by toolcall_id + reconciliation job that converts provisional->confirmed and subtracts replaced tokens within 10s window. I'll draft RFC
Kevin O'Hare: also add server-side idempotency token to toolcall API and reject duplicates within TTL
Samir Patel: owner? Maria + Kevin to write RFC, Liz to sketch console changes, Tara to add telemetry fields. I'll open a ticket
Maria Chen: TY. I'll drop initial RFC in #eng-platform by EOD. :thumbsup:
Liz Wong: i'll mock a console mockup tomorrow
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-721 (owner: Samir Patel) linked to alert #C-2245
Tara Singh: quick note — add unit test for the corner case where client truncates stream after toolcall finish but before ack loops
Maria Chen: good call. Will include tests.
